intro: This Fruit Could Bite Back is a foraging quest focused on collecting wild prickly pears in the arid lands near Orgrimmar. The fruits are prepared into food while their seeds are saved for future planting, with the aim of cultivating a resilient desert crop to nourish the Horde capital.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our hunters and fishers bring back plenty of savory food for our troops - but it's rare that they get a sweet treat.

I've seen a cactus that produces a prickly, tasty fruit. But it only grows in the hills to the west, where the wretched quilboars make their camps. Make your way past the quilboars and bring me some of those fruits. And be careful - the fruits are as spiny as the quilboars!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'll use these to prepare something tasty, and save the seeds for planting. Someday we'll have prickly pears growing all around Orgrimmar!
